title: Accepting gratification by public officer
question: What does Cpo Act 2000 section 8 say about accepting gratification by public officer?
shortAnswer: Cpo Act 2000 s.8 — Offence: public officer asks/accepts gratification for official act; penalty: imprisonment up to 7 years.
legalExplanation:
**Section 8 of the Cpo Act 2000** provides:

Offence: public officer asks/accepts gratification for official act; penalty: imprisonment up to 7 years

This provision empowers Cpo Act 2000 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
